versions.changelog:
Initial release of visualization-chart-generation skill.

- Generates charts in SVG, HTML, or HTML+JS formats, following a unified design specification.
- Supports static, interactive, and complex data visualizations, with integrated Chart.js and D3.js for advanced needs.
- Features a built-in visual design system covering color, typography, layout, and reusable components.
- Provides templates and references for various chart types, with clear format selection rules.
- Enables saving charts as images via browser, ensuring all output files are user-friendly and compatible.
